title: U.S. data-centre electricity scale comparator
description: LBNL's 2024 historical estimate and 2030 reference and compounded-uncertainty estimates.
plainLanguageSummary: LBNL estimates U.S. data centres used 192 TWh in 2024 and gives a 2030 reference estimate of 649 TWh, with a compounded-uncertainty range of 521–843 TWh.
howToRead: The 2024 historical estimate and 2030 scenario points are separated in time. The chart does not fill in an annual trajectory between them.

calculation.formula: LBNL U.S. data-centre electricity use estimates, reported in TWh per year.
calculation.explanation: Only the 2024 historical estimate and 2030 scenario endpoints are plotted; no annual path between them is inferred.
calculation.example: A value at date t uses only observations dated t or earlier unless the chart explicitly labels a visual shift.

patternsToWatch: The wide range around the 2030 reference case
How future LBNL reports revise historical estimates and forecast assumptions
limitations: U.S. data-centre totals are a scale comparator, not a forecast for Canada.
The totals cover data centres generally and are not AI-only electricity use.
The 2030 compounded-uncertainty cases combine multiple sensitivities and are not confidence intervals.
sourceNotes: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, United States Data Center Energy Usage Report: 2025 Update, June 2026
